segments.label: Budget-constrained, cautious, and restricted
segments.hypothesis: Recommendations should emphasize low-cost safe substitutions and explicitly honor medical or allergy constraints.

segments.label: Plant-based and values-led
segments.hypothesis: Plans should consistently remain plant-based and reject ingredients that conflict with ethical restrictions.

segments.label: Convenience-first, infrequent meal preparation
segments.hypothesis: Plans should favor simple meals, few preparation steps, and realistic convenience substitutions.

segments.label: Nutrition-aware, regular planners
segments.hypothesis: Plans should be more structured and the personas should ask detailed nutrition and follow-up questions.
